configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.displayName: Release with Ninja, tests and install on
configurePresets.description: Reproduces the configuration this repository is verified with. Build output goes under .tmp/, so no IDE ever grows cmake-build-* in the repository root again. Using presets needs CMake 3.21 or newer; the library itself still needs only 3.17.

configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.displayName: Release with Ninja + MSVC, tests and install on
configurePresets.description: The second measured leg (2026-10-21): MSVC 19.51 / VS2026 with Ninja. START IT FROM A DEVELOPER SHELL ('x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS2026', or anything that has run vcvars64.bat) -- a preset cannot set that environment, and cl.exe without it cannot find its own STL headers (every TU fails with C1083 'cstdint'). Recipe and results: the 2026-10-21 measurement recorded in docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md section 6b (the docs/HISTORY.md this line used to cite was retired on 2026-10-23). Do not switch this to the 'Visual Studio 17 2022' generator: CMake 3.30 cannot find a VS2026 instance that way (measured).

configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.displayName: Release with Ninja + Clang, tests and install on
configurePresets.description: The third measured leg (2026-10-21): Clang 22.1.4 targeting x86_64-pc-windows-msvc. Needs the same Developer Shell as the msvc preset, because clang-cl-style Windows targets still link with link.exe and need the MSVC headers/libraries. Compiler names are left to PATH on purpose: the absolute path of a local LLVM tree is not something to bake into a repository preset. Results: 50/50 ctest.
